## Highlights

- Select Markdown source and copy, cut, or paste without leaving the editor.
- Choose from 14 themes with a searchable, live-preview theme picker.
- Keep wiki links pointing at the same notes when renaming or moving files.

## Selection and clipboard shortcuts

- **Shift+arrows** selects text across lines and soft wraps; **Shift+Home/End** extends to the start/end of the logical line.
- **Ctrl+C** copies the selection, **Ctrl+X** cuts it, and **Ctrl+V** pastes, replacing selected text.
- **Shortcut change: Ctrl+C no longer quits. Use Ctrl+Q to save and quit.**
- Typing, Enter, Backspace, and Delete replace/remove selected text. Escape clears the selection.
- Selection respects emoji and combining characters. A selection count also appears in the footer.
- Cut removes text only after a successful clipboard write. Failed operations, empty clipboards, and delayed replies after further input leave the text intact.
- Clipboard access uses native Windows APIs. Linux uses `wl-clipboard` on Wayland or `xclip`/`xsel` on X11. Terminal bracketed paste works without these helpers and remains available over SSH.
- Clipboard and terminal paste share validation: up to **1 MiB per paste** and **10,000 lines per note**, accounting for replaced text. CRLF/CR line endings become LF.
- F1 help now scrolls so all shortcuts remain reachable in smaller terminals.

Ctrl+Z continues to undo trash operations; general text-edit undo is not included in this release.

## Themes

**Ctrl+T** opens the theme chooser. Type to filter, use arrows to preview, press Enter to keep the choice, or Escape to restore the previous theme.

- Coyote Dark and Light
- Ayu Dark, Mirage, and Light
- Catppuccin Mocha, Macchiato, Frappé, and Latte
- Nord
- Tokyo Night
- Dracula
- Gruvbox Dark and Light

Themes cover the editor, selection, Markdown preview, syntax highlighting, and application chrome. Existing `dark` and `light` settings remain valid.

## Fixes

- Moving a note preserves the destinations of its outgoing links, even when duplicate file names exist in the new folder.
- Renaming a note no longer silently redirects unrelated links when the new name changes resolution priority.
- Wiki-link parsing respects code-fence characters and lengths, keeping code examples out of backlinks and rename rewriting.
- Wrapping and vertical cursor movement use complete graphemes and the actual display grid.

## Downloads and validation

Archives are available for **Linux and Windows**, on **amd64 and arm64**, with `SHA256SUMS`. Archives include the README with the editor’s third-party license.

Automated checks cover race tests, vet, responsive layouts in all 14 themes, clipboard failures and timeouts, and a Linux PTY flow for selection/copy/cut/paste. Native Windows clipboard behavior still needs a manual Windows Terminal check.
